story.title: The Word Pond

panels.desc: Bun, Hedgie and Pip step through a gap in the wooden fence of the Sound Garden (blossoming letter trees behind them) onto the sandy bank of a wide blue pond with lily pads and tall reeds; across the water stands a dark pine forest. The glowing golden seed with its tiny leaf from the end of Book 1 floats down and lands on the sand, where big round wooden beads lie scattered. Pip, who can chirp now, has its beak open with one tiny golden note. Bun points across the water; Hedgie looks worried. Grumble does NOT appear.
panels.ko: 담장 틈으로 나오니 넓은 파란 연못이에요. 씨앗이 모래에 내려앉고 나무 구슬이 흩어져 있어요. 건너갈 돌이 없어요!

panels.desc: Beads, a small friendly caterpillar whose body is a string of five rainbow beads, pops up from a lily pad at the pond edge holding a string with three loose wooden beads and clicks two of them together. Pip hops right up to Beads, delighted; Bun and Hedgie lean in with big eyes. On the left, among the tall reeds, the tip of Grumble's striped nightcap and the warm glow of his lantern peek out.

lines.text: Shh... Who is in the reeds?

panels.ko: 연잎에서 구슬 애벌레 비즈가 나타나 구슬을 딸깍 부딪쳐요. 갈대 속에 그럼블 모자와 불빛이 보여요.

story.synopsis_ko: 담장 너머에 넓은 단어 연못이 있어요. 건너갈 돌이 없어요! 구슬 애벌레 비즈를 만났어요. 갈대 속에서 그럼블의 등불이 보여요.
story.so_far_ko: 1권에서 친구들은 스물여섯 글자나무를 키우고 핍은 소리를 되찾았어요. 씨앗 하나가 담장 너머로 날아갔어요.
story.goal_ko: 단어 연못에 닿아 새 친구 비즈를 만나요.

videos.prompt: Gentle picture-book animation: the golden seed drifts down and lands softly on the sand with a sparkle, the pond water ripples, the reeds sway, the baby bird chirps one tiny glowing note; the rabbit and the hedgehog look across the water. Camera still. Calm, curious, child-friendly. No text.
